name: Metadata Stripping
summary: Removes non-essential embedded metadata (EXIF GPS tags, camera serials, author comments, thumbnail caches).
analogy: Removing shipping tags and price stickers from a gift box before putting it into a package.
what_you_gain: Enhances personal privacy (removes GPS coordinates) and saves 10-100 KB per photo without touching pixels.
what_you_lose: Camera settings, timestamp history, and geolocation metadata are permanently deleted.
best_for: Privacy-conscious sharing and optimizing collections with thousands of camera photos.
avoid_for: Professional photography archives where camera settings, copyright info, and color profiles must be kept.
go_deeper: Strips auxiliary APP1/EXIF, XMP, and IPTC header segments from file containers while preserving image payload bitstreams.
